name: param-uq-03-growth-stratified
title: Growth-stratified sensitivity — how does parameter influence vary across the cell cycle?
claim:
(planned) Parameter influence on growth/mass is stage-dependent across the
cell cycle, with elongation mattering most mid-cycle during peak biosynthesis.
question:
Does the sensitivity of growth/mass to the elongation knobs change across
cell-cycle progress θ (birth→division)? (RFC006 strategy 4.)
hypothesis:
Parameter influence is stage-dependent: elongation knobs (especially
basal_elongation_rate) matter most mid-cycle during peak biosynthetic activity,
and less so early (small cell, limited ribosome pool) and late (resources
committed to division).

report.title: param-uq-03-growth-stratified — cell-cycle-stratified Sobol sensitivity
report.objective:
Determine whether the elongation-rate dominance found in param-uq-01
(instantaneous_growth_rate, short window) and param-uq-02 (multi-observable,
360 steps) is uniform across the cell cycle or concentrated in specific
phases. Per-stage Sobol indices would reveal whether sensitivity is
episodic, guiding targeted intervention strategies.
report.setup:
Approach (RFC006 strategy 4):
- Run multi-generation simulations through ≥1 cell division (each ~2760 steps).
- Compute cell-cycle progress: θ = [log m(t) − log m_birth] / [log m_div − log m_birth],
  binned into 10 equal stages from birth (θ=0) to division (θ=1).
- For each stage bin, compute per-stage Sobol indices from the 3 effective
  elongation knobs (same as param-uq-01/02).

Infrastructure requirements:
(a) Multi-generation runs that record birth/division events — significantly
    slower than the 120–360-step windows used so far (~2760 steps per generation).
(b) Re-adding the growth-stratified aggregation strategy to pbg-uq (this was
    intentionally dropped from the thin core to keep the package minimal).

Parameters: same 3 effective knobs (basal_elongation_rate, kS,
chrom.basal_elongation_rate) with the same bounds as param-uq-01.
report.result: RESULTS PENDING — study not yet run.

model_settings.name: multigen-required
model_settings.detail: Multi-generation runs required (≥1 division, ~2760 steps/gen); significantly slower than short-window studies.

model_settings.name: stratification-strategy-needed
model_settings.detail: Growth-stratified aggregation strategy must be re-added to pbg-uq before this study can run.

model_settings.name: cell-cycle-binning
model_settings.detail: θ bins: 10 equal-width stages from birth (0) to division (1), computed from log-mass trajectory.

assumptions.text:
The cell-cycle progress metric θ = [log m(t) − log m_birth] / [log m_div − log m_birth]
captures biologically meaningful stages. Division timing must be reliably
detected from the mass trajectory.

The 3 effective knobs from the 120-step screen remain the right parameter
set for cell-cycle-stratified analysis. No new knobs are expected to appear
at specific cell-cycle stages.

tests.name: per-stage-sensitivity-profile
tests.question:
Does basal_elongation_rate show significantly different Sobol indices across
cell-cycle stages (i.e., is sensitivity non-uniform across θ)?

measure.detail:
(TBD) Will compute per-stage total-order Sobol for basal_elongation_rate
across 10 θ bins and test whether the range (max − min) exceeds a
meaningful threshold indicating stage-dependence.
